content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) helps women in low-income countryside homes replace smoke-producing solid cooking materials with bottled gas. Launched in May 2016 by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, PMUY provides free LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) connections to women from below-poverty-line and deprived households [E02]. The scheme aims to make clean cooking fuel available to rural households that were traditionally using firewood, coal, and cow-dung cakes [E02].
